record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Completeness of (A) + extremality as axiom system for F_p((t))
record.original_question: Let p be a prime and F_p the field with p elements. An extremal valued field is a valued field (K, v) such that for every multivariate polynomial f(X_1, ..., X_n) over K, the set {v(f(a_1,...,a_n)) | a_1,...,a_n in O_K} (where O_K is the valuation ring) has a maximal element in vK union {infinity}. This is an L_val-elementary axiom scheme. The L_val-elementary axiom system (A) is: 'henselian defectless valued field of positive characteristic with value group a Z-group and residue field F_p.' It is known (Kuhlmann 2001) that (A) alone is not complete. It is also known (Azgin-Kuhlmann-Pop 2012) that F_p((t)) is an extremal field. Is the axiom system (A) together with the extremality axiom scheme — that is, the theory of henselian defectless valued fields of positive characteristic with Z-group value group, residue field F_p, and extremality — a complete axiom system for the L_val-theory of F_p((t))?

evidence.quote: Open problem 10: Is (A) + "(K, v) is extremal" a complete axiom system?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $\mathbb{F}_p$ denote the field with $p$ elements. Work in the language $L_{\mathrm{val}}$ of valued fields. For a valued field $(K,v)$ write $\mathcal{O}_K$ for its valuation ring and $vK$ for its value group.

Call $(K,v)$ extremal if for every $n\ge 1$ and every polynomial $f(X_1,\dots,X_n)\in K[X_1,\dots,X_n]$, the set
$$\{\,v(f(a_1,\dots,a_n)) : a_1,\dots,a_n\in\mathcal{O}_K\,\}\subseteq vK\cup\{\infty\}$$
attains a maximum. Extremality is expressible by an $L_{\mathrm{val}}$-elementary axiom scheme.

Let (A) be the $L_{\mathrm{val}}$-axiom system asserting that $(K,v)$ is a henselian, defectless valued field of characteristic $p>0$ whose value group $vK$ is a $\mathbb{Z}$-group (i.e. elementarily equivalent to $\mathbb{Z}$ as an ordered abelian group) and whose residue field is $\mathbb{F}_p$.

It is known that (A) alone is not complete, and that the field $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ of formal Laurent series over $\mathbb{F}_p$ with the $t$-adic valuation is extremal and satisfies (A).

Question: Is the theory consisting of (A) together with the extremality axiom scheme a complete axiomatization of the $L_{\mathrm{val}}$-theory of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of a complete recursive axiomatization of the elementary theory of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ is widely cited as open. The proposed enhancement of the Ax–Kochen–Ershov-style axioms by adding extremality is discussed in Kuhlmann's notes on extremal and tame valued fields and in the 2025 survey on tame valued fields, where it is listed among open problems; no completeness proof appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Notes on Extremal and Tame Valued Fields (Kuhlmann)
status_evidence.snippet: A more elegant axiom scheme using extremality was proposed after Ershov, but a complete characterization is not known and there are many open problems about extremal fields.
status_evidence.claim: Completeness of the extremality-augmented axiom system for F_p((t)) is not established.

status_evidence.title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond
status_evidence.snippet: Open problem: Is (A) + '(K,v) is extremal' a complete axiom system?
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as open in a 2025 survey.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of extremal valued fields (Azgin–Kuhlmann–Pop)
status_evidence.snippet: F_p((t)) is shown to be an extremal valued field; full characterization of extremal fields remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Extremality of F_p((t)) is known but does not yield a known completeness result.
